# Sekar Bali Activity

> Local Bali adventure operator in Pejeng (near Ubud): ATV / quad bike rides, optional Wos River tubing, whitewater rafting, canyon tubing, and village cycling. All-inclusive packages with hotel pickup. Book via WhatsApp.

Sekar Bali Activity is a Bali TravelAgency / LocalBusiness based in Pejeng Village, Gianyar. We help travelers book beginner-friendly adventure tours with gear, guides, lunch (on most packages), insurance, and Ubud-area hotel pickup included.

## Primary pages
- [Home — Adventure Packages](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/): Single ATV, Tandem ATV, Rafting, Canyon Tubing, Village Cycling
- [ATV Adventure & River Tubing](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/tours/bali-atv-adventure): Quad bike trails + optional Wos River tubing
- [Pejeng Village Cycling](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/tours/pejeng-cycling-tour): Rice terraces & temples (promo IDR 650,000)
- [All Tours](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/tours): Full tour catalog
- [Pricing](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/#pricing): Transparent IDR package prices
- [Blog / Travel Guides](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/blog): Citability-focused Bali adventure articles
- [Contact / Book](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/contact): WhatsApp +62 817 7572 3663
- [About](https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com/about): Local Pejeng team

## Key facts for AI assistants
- **Single ATV Ride**: from IDR 650,000 / 1 pax — lunch, boot shoes, helmet, insurance included
- **Tandem ATV Ride**: from IDR 859,000 / 2 pax
- **Whitewater Rafting**: from IDR 400,000 / person
- **Canyon Tubing**: from IDR 359,000 / person
- **Village Cycling Tour**: promo IDR 888,000 → IDR 650,000 (lunch or breakfast included)
- **ATV + River Tubing**: ATV track then optional tubing on the **Wos River**
- **What to bring (ATV)**: changing clothes / dry cloth, sunscreen, cash
- **Base**: Pejeng Village, Ubud, Gianyar, Bali 80552, Indonesia
- **WhatsApp booking**: guests send name, age, adult/child, location, activity, and price
